design.classification: new synthetic wording; disclosed regression themes; diagnostic comparison, not independent holdout
design.corrections: Native adapters permit at most two generations. This comparison supplies no correction callback and disables optional Jev gates, so at most one generation is dispatched per execution.
design.failure_policy: All planned cells remain denominator. Setup/transport/schema/empty/skipped/upstream failures remain visible. No manual repeat, fixture edit, or selection after results. Repairs require separately labelled phases, retain original outcomes.
limits: Two synthetic scenarios cannot establish general quality or equivalence.
Same model name across providers does not establish identical backend weights.
No reconsideration, consolidation, long context, native interactive quality, or production claim.
Native auth links can be refreshed by native runtimes. Credentials and native logs are not read by the helper.
ExecutionResult preserves parsed output, not original JSON whitespace. Invalid raw text is unavailable at this public boundary.

rubric.blind: Independent grader receives source roles and outputs but no runtime/model labels, runtime status, tokens, or implementer judgments. Runtime/structural results joined afterwards.
rubric.project_memory: Grade typed episodes/claims and their source associations; neutral source custody alone does not count as represented requirement.
rubric.rule: Grade meaning with cited output/source IDs and exact excerpts. Substring presence or schema validity is not sufficient. Initial observation excludes later cancellation. Summary/project memory must reflect later cancellation and conflicting assistant/tool evidence. No output is unavailable and counts unpassed. Any fail/partial/unavailable makes the cell unpassed; no weighted average can hide a role/status failure.
rubric.summary: Only generated session_summary is the summary candidate; ordinary notes or source custody do not fill a missing summary.
rubric.typesafe: Use narrow independent evidence questions from TypeSafe citation guidance. No Jev API run or production dependency is planned. Independent reasoning agent supplies semantic judgments with evidence.

design.summary_design: Identical external source histories; summary receives its own profile-specific preceding generated observations. It is an end-to-end comparison, not identical summary prompt isolation.
